response.overview: Eight-year-old Bayu, the son of a fisherman, spends his days living alongside his father in a coastal village. One afternoon, before leaving for the sea, Bayu’s father entrusts him with money to be offered as part of the local sea alms tradition. Instead, Bayu uses the money to buy a new toy.  The next day, his father does not return home. For the first time, Bayu is left to face fear and regret over what he has done with the money entrusted to him. Carrying the toy back to the shore, Bayu sets out to find his father, only to encounter an unexpected discovery that forces him to question everything he thought he knew.
response.title: LABUH
